scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && node scripts/ensure-dependencies.mjs --record-only && npm run -w backend prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend typecheck && npm run -w frontend build
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run -w backend test && npm run -w frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend typecheck
scripts.check:fast: npm run test && npm run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run -w frontend build && npm run smoke:backend
